root_idea.summary: The root centers on withholding or restraint, and on remaining still in place.
root_idea.development: From abstaining from an act—especially eating, drinking, speaking, or travelling—the root develops the religious sense of fasting and several Classical extensions involving stillness, stationary objects, and standing-places.

senses.definition: To fast; to abstain from food and drink and, in the prescribed ritual formulation, from sexual intercourse.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic Form I imperfect occurrences concern fasting, including fasting during the Ramadan period. The broader absolute sense of refraining from an act is Classical Arabic usage and is listed separately.

senses.definition: Abstention from speech; silence, specifically the abstention vowed in the Quranic construction صَوْمًا.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Maryam passage, this usage is interpreted in connection with the following declaration not to speak. It is distinct from the ordinary food-and-drink fasting sense.

senses.definition: Fasting; the prescribed observance of abstaining from food and drink and, in the legal formulation, from sexual intercourse.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for prescribed fasting and for compensatory or expiatory fasts in Quranic legal constructions.

senses.definition: One who fasts; a person characterized by fasting.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran attests masculine and feminine plural forms of the active participle; they are presented here under the singular dictionary citation form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To refrain or hold back from an act; in absolute usage, to withhold from eating, speaking, or travelling, or to remain without work.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: General or non-technical usage, distinct from the prescribed ritual sense of fasting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to stand still, especially without eating fodder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended use applied specifically to a horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become stationary or still: of the sun at full height, the day at midday, the wind, or water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Tropical or assumed-tropical applications to celestial, temporal, and natural phenomena.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an ostrich or domestic fowl, to cast forth dung.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Classical usage associated with the stillness accompanying the act.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To taste or experience one's death.
To shade oneself by means of the tree called صَوْم.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical use tied to the named tree.

other_classical_meanings.definition: By metonymy, Ramadan, the month of fasting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A time-name usage, as in remaining for or passing two Ramadans.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A Christian church, understood as a place of fasting or religious station.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical or assumed-tropical noun usage.
A specialized noun usage corresponding to the related verb application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the dialect of Hudhayl, a certain tree or group of trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal botanical usage; the singular may occur with the feminine ending صَوْمَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dry land or ground in which there is no water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression أَرْضٌ صَوَامٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A habitual or intensive faster or abstainer; one who fasts often.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive derivative of the participial fasting sense, often paired with frequent night prayer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An abstainer; one who refrains generally, including from food, speech, or travelling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Absolute and extended Classical usage of the active participle, apart from the specifically Quranic fasting use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Still or motionless, as of a horse, a pulley sheave, or water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended adjectival use applied to things that remain stationary.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A station or standing-place; also a place where an astral body is suspended or where the sun is at mid-heaven.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for a horse's standing-place and, by extension, for the apparent station of the Pleiades or the sun.

cautions: The Quranic صَوْم in Maryam 19:26 carries the specifically attested sense of abstention from speech, distinct from ritual food-and-drink fasting. The modern example location follows the supplied QAC occurrence rather than treating a historical printed citation as a modern verse reference.
